_comment: Row-shape reference for the two tables schema.sql defines -- nodes and edges. This is not sample data; schema.sql's own INSERT statements already carry this kit's populated worked example (the Elm Street tool-cabinet scenario). A node's 'data' field is a JSON-encoded string, not a nested object, because SQLite columns hold text/integer/real/blob/null and nothing structured -- parse it before reading type-specific fields like a Person's aliases.

node.data: <JSON-encoded string of type-specific fields, e.g. '{"name":"Kavita","aliases":["Mrs K"]}'>

edge.from_id: <foreign key into nodes.id -- the edge's subject>
edge.to_id: <foreign key into nodes.id -- the edge's object>
edge.label: <relationship type, e.g. 'owns', 'borrowed', 'returned'>
edge.source_doc: <the source document this edge was extracted from>
edge.extraction_run_id: <the id of the extraction run that produced this edge>
edge.schema_version: <the schema version active when this edge was written>
